ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 3 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 8
   C. 5
   D. 3

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

4. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 17
   D. 0

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 1
   D. 7

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

8. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 25

9. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

10. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 2

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 11

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
